blurb: Lucky 13 Charters offers inshore and offshore fishing charters, sandbar hopping, sunset cruises, and dolphin tours around Sarasota, Siesta Key, Venice, Longboat Key, and Bradenton. They provide all necessary fishing licenses, equipment, tackle, and bait. Trips accommodate up to 6 guests and cover various fishing experiences from inshore to offshore.
